entries.title: Job 23:2
segments: "Even today my complaint is bitter; My hand is listless because of my groaning.

entries.title: Job 23:3
segments: Oh, that I knew where I might find Him, [That] I might come to His seat!

entries.title: Job 23:4
segments: I would present [my] case before Him, And fill my mouth with arguments.

entries.title: Job 23:5
segments: I would know the words [which] He would answer me, And understand what He would say to me.

entries.title: Job 23:6
segments: Would He contend with me in His great power? No! But He would take [note] of me.

entries.title: Job 23:7
segments: There the upright could reason with Him, And I would be delivered forever from my Judge.

entries.title: Job 23:8
segments: ¶"Look, I go forward, but He is not [there], And backward, but I cannot perceive Him;

entries.title: Job 23:9
segments: When He works on the left hand, I cannot behold [Him]; When He turns to the right hand, I cannot see [Him].

entries.title: Job 23:10
segments: But He knows the way that I take; [When] He has tested me, I shall come forth as gold.

entries.title: Job 23:11
segments: My foot has held fast to His steps; I have kept His way and not turned aside.

entries.title: Job 23:12
segments: I have not departed from the commandment of His lips; I have treasured the words of His mouth More than my necessary [food].

entries.title: Job 23:13
segments: ¶"But He [is] unique, and who can make Him change? And [whatever] His soul desires, [that] He does.

entries.title: Job 23:14
segments: For He performs [what is] appointed for me, And many such [things are] with Him.

entries.title: Job 23:15
segments: Therefore I am terrified at His presence; When I consider [this], I am afraid of Him.

entries.title: Job 23:16
segments: For God made my heart weak, And the Almighty terrifies me;

entries.title: Job 23:17
segments: Because I was not cut off from the presence of darkness, And He did [not] hide deep darkness from my face.
